subject: English
passage: A small business owner who operates without proper permits risks facing hefty fines from local authorities. The most effective way to avoid penalties is to obtain all required licenses before opening. Completing one of these necessary applications ______ an entrepreneur won't encounter legal troubles.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "ensures" agrees in number with the singular subject "completing."
